feeds.title: Get In Her Ears
feeds.description: Get In Her Ears is a website founded by Mari Lane, Tash Walker, and Kate Crudgington. Monthly Soho Radio show, and live night dedicated to promoting and supporting women & non-binary people in music. We aspire to the music industry and gig environment which is free from sexual assault and any form of harassment.

feeds.title: Raw Femme
feeds.description: Latina-owned, Raw Femme began as an online publication in 2013 that put a spotlight on the talent of emerging women-identifying artists. We are a multi-faceted, artistically inclined platform fueled by creative and artistic women that host local women-centric events, produce online editorial content, and collaborate with other like-minded organizations.

feeds.title: She Makes Music
feeds.description: She Makes Music highlights and puts focus on the best new music made by female-identifying and non-binary artists from all around the world on their website. Keep up-to-date with the music world and discover more brilliant music made by women in this music blog by Helen Evans.

feeds.title: It's Her Factory
feeds.description: Robin James is a writer, editor, and former associate professor of philosophy at UNC Charlotte. She's an expert in feminism/gender/race and popular music, pop music and politics, sound studies, electronic dance music studies, and contemporary continental philosophy (especially critical theories of neoliberalism and biopolitics).

feeds.title: Girl Gang Music
feeds.description: Girl Gang Music was founded in 2016 by music producer/artist and activist Jen Miller, is a curated community and network of women and nonbinary humans within the music industry. Its mission is to promote community and inclusion for women and gender-diverse people across all aspects of the music industry.

feeds.title: The Autumn Roses
feeds.description: Looking for new and best songs to add to your playlist? Then look no further! At The Autumn Roses, all we care about is good music by exceptional artists. Read about them and their music through our blog.

feeds.title: The Forty-Five
feeds.description: The Forty-Five is a new music publication, created by a collective of female-led music journalists, creatives, and photographers, founded by former NME Editor, Charlie Gunn. Get music reviews, interviews, opinions, podcasts, and more from The Forty-Five's team of expert journalists, around the world.

feeds.title: Highway Queens
feeds.description: This is a music blog mainly reviewing new albums by women in Americana, country, folk, and indie - although no genre is off limits if the work is interesting. Also expect live reviews, features on classic albums, and general music opinion pieces.

feeds.title: LOUD WOMEN
feeds.description: LOUD WOMEN is a group for all those who support putting women on stage and turning up the volume. It's a not-for-profit initiative run by Cassie Fox of I, Doris, with help from some brilliant friends. Here, you'll find women-centric music, punk, rock, and much more.

feeds.title: Women In Pop
feeds.description: Read articles and interviews focusing on female-oriented music, achievements, and issues faced by them in the industry. Women in Pop is a print magazine focusing solely on female musicians. We profile their stories, their music, and their craft as well as explore the herstory and gender politics behind the pop music industry.

feeds.title: Jejune Magazine » Music
feeds.description: Jejune Magazine is a socially aware fashion, celebrity, and art magazine that gives a much-needed political voice to the population. We cover current events in the world, highlight people giving back, and give a platform for discussion through imagery, fashion, art, and written words. Read about music in the following section of the magazine.

feeds.title: Prism DJs Blog
feeds.description: Launched in 2015 by Tessa Young, PRISM DJs is a Los Angeles-based collective and booking agency representing an eclectic roster of dynamic women DJs. PRISM DJs' mission is to create a supportive network for women DJs and advocate for gender equality in the music industry. Discover articles, blog posts, music videos, mix tracks, and samples by our eclectic roster of dynamic female artists in the music and DJ industry.

feeds.title: Girls Make Beats Blog
feeds.description: Girls Make Beats is a nonprofit organization that empowers girls by expanding the female presence of music producers, DJs, and audio engineers.GMB works with girls ages 5-17 and hosts educational seminars, summer camps, industry panels, and networking events. GMB helps girls further their careers as music producers, DJs, and audio engineers by providing courses on industry-leading hardware and software.

feeds.title: shesaid.so » Drum & Bass
feeds.description: shesaid.so is a global independent community of women and gender nonconforming people in the music industry. Our mission is to connect and empower underrepresented communities toward a more equitable music industry for all, one woman or gender-nonconforming person at a time.

feeds.title: Women of Substance Blog
feeds.description: The Women of Substance Music Podcast features music by Female Indie Artists every Monday, Wednesday, Friday. We've been #1 in iTunes New & Noteworthy in multiple categories & received the Podcaster's Paradise Award for Most Creative Podcast and receive 10,000+ downloads per month from loyal listeners.

feeds.title: Women's International Music Network Blog
feeds.description: The Women's International Music Network brings together women from all facets of the music industry. The WiMN seeks to create a hub to connect women in all facets of the music industry and works to expose role models, events, and educational opportunities that focus on women in music.

feeds.title: The F-List for Music Blog
feeds.description: The F-List Directory of UK Female+ Musicians. Discover some of the best female+ musicians in the UK. Follow our blog to know more about these artists and their work. We cover various female artists on our blog page.

feeds.title: Girl Underground Music
feeds.description: Girl Underground Music is primarily a place for local, and lesser known artists, voices to be discovered and heard, through the form of interviews, music reviews, and in the old art of sharing music.

feeds.title: DJ Kara Blog
feeds.description: You will find Kara DJ'ing often at a wide range of events -including weddings, corporate events, and private parties - while also staying She continues to focus on refining her skills, growing her agency, working with great talented people, and fully enjoying the journey.

feeds.title: Guitar Girl Magazine
feeds.description: Get the latest music industry news, interviews of some of the best female guitarists around, guitar gear reviews, album and concert reviews, rock star fashion trends, and tips and advice on navigating your way to becoming a guitar guru.

feeds.title: Musicwoman Magazine
feeds.description: MUSICWOMAN blog began in 2008, by Dr. Joan Cartwright, Jazz/Blues vocalist, composer, producer, educator, author, editor, publisher, founder, and director of Women in Jazz South Florida Inc., a non-profit organization that promotes women musicians, globally. WIJSF publishes Musicwoman Magazine and Musicman Magazine.

feeds.title: Donne Blog
feeds.description: Donne, Women in music is a charitable foundation that celebrates, advances, and amplifies women in music. We are a global community of women, gender minorities, and allies in the music industry. We are dedicated to achieving gender equality in the music industry. We are here to connect and empower anyone who identifies as a woman in order to create a more equitable music industry.

feeds.title: International Alliance for Women in Music
feeds.description: The International Alliance for Women in Music (IAWM) is an international membership organization of women and men dedicated to fostering and encouraging the activities of women in music, particularly in the areas of musical activity such as composing, performing, and research in which gender discrimination is an historic and ongoing concern.

feeds.title: Audiofemme
feeds.description: Welcome to AudioFemme! We started this website as a way to showcase women writing about music. Here you'll find reviews, rants, and raves covering many genres of music, written from honest and passionate perspectives.

feeds.title: The F-Word » Music
feeds.description: The F-Word writes about Music in this segment of the blog. They will be sharing a little about Politics, Film & TV, Books, and more. The F-Word is an online magazine dedicated to talking about and sharing ideas on contemporary UK feminism. We publish feminist reviews, blogs, and features. We promote discussion of contemporary feminism.

feeds.title: Indie Witches
feeds.description: Madison started Indie Witches because she was tired of writing about white male bands that all sounded the same. Indie Witches is a music blog featuring women artists from around the world!

feeds.title: Indie Music Women
feeds.description: Stay up to date with reviews, interviews, candid analysis, and news of women in the indie music industry. I'm Linda Garnett and I give talented women in the Indie Music field the information, connections, and attention they need to propel the growth of their career.

feeds.title: SheBOPS
feeds.description: SheBOPS is a fresh and vibrant music site, exclusively covering as many of the world's most brilliant female musicians as humanly possible. It's the Internet's premier site for Girl Power in the music industry!

feeds.title: Women Who Rock Blog
feeds.description: The blog features articles on Women who Rock in various aspects. Women Who Rock is a crusade to champion women in music and women's health awareness. The site connects through the power of music and helps to educate, support and fund women-centric health and music endeavors.

feeds.title: Illuminate Women's Music Blog
feeds.description: Illuminate is a project to promote the work of emerging women composers and performers. It also gives a platform for historical repertoire by women composers to sit alongside new works. The project has been set up by Dr Angela Elizabeth Slater in 2017, a freelance composer who is a strong advocate of the promotion of women's music both past and present.

feeds.title: Womxn Who Rock Blog
feeds.description: The Womxn Who Rock Community Research Project is developed through collaborations between UW faculty, graduate students, community members, and scholars of gender, race, and sexuality in music and social justice movements. We bring together musicians, media-makers, performers, artists, scholars, and activists to explore the role of women and popular music in the creation of cultural scenes that anchor social justice movements in the Americas and beyond.

feeds.title: Amplify Her Voice Blog
feeds.description: Amplify Her Voice is a dynamic organization that boldly advocates for gender equality in the music industry. We advance women's careers through educational, networking, and creative opportunities by providing our community with valuable events, programs, and support to not just work, but thrive in the music industry.

feeds.title: She Shreds
feeds.description: SheShreds is a thriving global reference center and online community for female action sports fans. The network connects and supports women who participate in sports like snowboarding, skateboarding, surfing, and other activities by providing a wide variety of information, such as articles, videos, and events. SheShreds offers a forum for women to exchange stories, counsel, and inspiration while promoting diversity and representation in action sports.

feeds.title: Pam Barrett Music Blog
feeds.description: Pam is a Madison-based songwriter best known for fronting the Motor Primitives, the Sigourney Weavers, and, most recently, Madison favorites, BingBong. Pam's throaty vibrato brings emotional immediacy to her melodic - at times portentous, at times rocking - songs. Listeners have described the songs as visually brilliant with characters who come alive.

feeds.title: FEMMUSIC Magazine
feeds.description: FEMMUSIC.com is an online magazine for emerging women in music. You'll articles and information covering various female artists and their music in this magazine.

feeds.title: Bitch Media » Music
feeds.description: Bitch Media's Mission is to provide and encourage engaged, thoughtful feminist music through this segment of the website. Bitch seeks to be a fresh, revitalizing voice in contemporary feminism, one that welcomes complex arguments and refuses to ignore the contradictory and often uncomfortable realities of life in an unequivocally gendered world.

feeds.title: FEMME RIOT » Music
feeds.description: FEMME RIOT is a collective of badass women who are sharing what they love with the world. Here we'll talk about badass female artists and their music.
